name: Secure SVG Upload
author: Fahim Reza

sections.description:
Secure SVG Upload lets you upload SVG files to your WordPress media library. With built-in sanitization that removes harmful content while preserving valid SVG markup, this plugin offers comprehensive protection and reliable management for your vector images.

Features

  • SVG Upload Support: Add SVG files directly to your media library.
  • Automatic Sanitization: Each SVG upload is cleaned by default to prevent security risks.

Privacy Policy

Secure SVG does not collect or store any personal data.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the secure-svg folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin via the WordPress ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Start uploading SVG files as you would with any other media.
sections.faq:
Is it safe to upload SVG files?

Yes. The plugin sanitizes SVG files to eliminate harmful elements while keeping the necessary markup intact.

What WordPress versions are supported?

Secure SVG is compatible with WordPress 5.0 and above.
